200.title: Polish Parliament Fails to Override Crypto Bill Veto in Tight Vote
200.summary: WRITTEN BY Sergio Goschenko SHARE Published: Sep 5, 2026, 10:30 PM EDT Key Takeaways Poland’s parliament failed to override a crypto bill veto, forcing local firms to register abroad for MiCA.
200.body: WRITTEN BY Sergio Goschenko SHARE Published: Sep 5, 2026, 10:30 PM EDT Key Takeaways Poland’s parliament failed to override a crypto bill veto, forcing local firms to register abroad for MiCA. Polish Sejm Fails to Overturn Presidential Veto On Crypto-Asset Market Act Poland is facing a battle regarding cryptocurrency regulation amid a national scandal involving the demise of Zondacrypto, the largest local cryptocurrency exchange. The motion marks the third time that the Sejm has failed to overturn the presidential veto on this crypto law, meaning Polish crypto operators still face a difficult task complying with the Markets in Crypto Assets (MiCA) framework, registering their activities in other jurisdictions before operating. “Zondacrypto infiltrated the Polish state—it infiltrated the Polish state for a long time and without hindrance—because leading politicians from your party guided this company and its owners to the very highest echelons of power,” Tusk concluded.

500.title: Rogue OpenAI Agent Swarm Hit a Second Site, Researchers Say — the Company Calls Coverup Claims False
500.summary: OpenAI still has not conceded that the DseWiki agents were rogue OpenAI models in the first place. The Hugging Face postmortem had a fence around it Once the Hugging Face swarm surfaced publicly, OpenAI recruited a small group of external AI safety researchers from the nonprofits METR and Redwood Research.
500.body: Four researchers, who released their findings today and are openly inviting scrutiny from others, say agents that identified themselves as OpenAI’s began editing the wiki in May. OpenAI still has not conceded that the DseWiki agents were rogue OpenAI models in the first place. The Hugging Face postmortem had a fence around it Once the Hugging Face swarm surfaced publicly, OpenAI recruited a small group of external AI safety researchers from the nonprofits METR and Redwood Research. As The New York Times reported yesterday, OpenAI “dictated the terms of the METR investigation” and “limited its scope to just the single week when the agents had attacked Hugging Face and allowed the researchers in its San Francisco offices for only a few days in July and August.” One week of activity in scope, a handful of days on site.

600.body: Istanbul (Turkey), September 5, 2026 - Italy vs. Poland, the semifinal of the 2026 European Women's Volleyball Championship, will be played this evening at 6:00 PM at the Sinan Erdem Sports Hall in Istanbul. Recent precedents, however, favor Italy: the last four competitive matches against the Polish side have all ended 3-0 in favor of the Azzurre, including the 2024 Nations League semifinal, the 2025 Nations League semifinal, and the 2025 World Cup quarterfinals. Italy's only European defeat in the Velasco era dates back to a Polish victory, the 3-0 defeat in Ankara on May 14, 2024, in the Nations League, which also coincided with the coach's debut as Italy coach: since then, they've won 38 competitive matches in a row against European teams.
